title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 25: the Sabbath year for the land, the Year of Jubilee, and caring for a brother who becomes poor.

questions.text: Where did Yahweh speak to Moses the laws of Leviticus 25?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Yahweh said these things to Moses in Mount Sinai.

questions.text: What were the Israelites not to do in the seventh year?
questions.explanation: The seventh year was a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land: they were not to sow their field or prune their vineyard.

answers.text: Sow their field or prune their vineyard

questions.text: How many years make up the seven Sabbaths of years?
questions.explanation: They were to count seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years, even forty-nine years.

questions.text: On which day was the loud trumpet to be sounded throughout the land?
questions.explanation: They were to sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month, on the Day of Atonement.

answers.text: On the first day of the year
On the first day of the feast of booths

questions.text: What were the Israelites to proclaim in the fiftieth year?
questions.explanation: They were to make the fiftieth year holy and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants; it would be a jubilee.

answers.text: A fast of seven days for all the people
War against the nations around the land
Liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants
A new king over all the tribes of Israel

questions.text: Why was the land not to be sold in perpetuity?
questions.explanation: Verse 23 says the land is Yahweh's, and the Israelites are strangers and foreigners with him.

answers.text: Because the land belongs to Yahweh
Because the priests own all the land
Because it was won in battle
Because the elders must approve every sale

questions.text: Within what time could a man redeem a house he had sold in a walled city?
questions.explanation: He could redeem it within a whole year after the sale; if not, it belonged to the buyer for good and was not released in the Jubilee.

questions.text: What does verse 36 forbid you to take from a brother who has become poor?
questions.explanation: Verse 36 says to take no interest or profit from him, but to fear God so that your brother may live among you.

questions.text: How long was an Israelite who sold himself to a fellow Israelite to serve?
questions.explanation: He was to be with his master as a hired servant and serve until the Year of Jubilee, then go out with his children.

answers.text: For the rest of his life

questions.text: Besides his brothers, who does verse 49 say may redeem an Israelite sold to a foreigner?
questions.explanation: One of his brothers may redeem him, or his uncle, or his uncle's son, or any close relative of his family, or he may redeem himself.

answers.text: His uncle or his uncle's son
